---
title: "Choosing suggestions"
description: "Keep, decline or pick up single suggestions of a bot PR by ticking checkboxes in its description."
---

A suggestion PR often mixes changes you want with ones you don't. Instead
of editing the bot's branch by hand, you choose in the PR's description:
every suggestion of the [roxygen](roxygen-suggest.qmd) and
[test suggestions](test-suggest.qmd) that changes a file is a checkbox.
`suggestion-choices.yml` makes the bot's branch match the boxes — no
Claude call, no git, all in the browser.

## What the boxes do

| Box | Ticked | Unticked |
|---|---|---|
| A new test | the test is in the file | it isn't; a test file left without tests is removed |
| An updated existing test | the bot's version | your original |
| A deleted existing test | the test is gone | your original is back |
| An applied roxygen change (title, a `@param`, …) | the bot's text | your original text, or no such field if you had none |
| A roxygen suggestion that wasn't applied (e.g. `clarity`) | the bot's text is applied | stays as it is |

Possible bugs, failed tests and notes are plain list items: they change
no file.

After a change, the workflow commits the result to the bot's branch
("chore: apply suggestion choices") and updates the description. A box
that can't be applied — e.g. the block can't be found any more — is set
back, with a note.

**Your choices are remembered.** A suggestion you unticked isn't proposed
again by later runs while the function's code stays the same; once the
code changes, it is crossed out as "declined, but the code changed
since" and may come back. Later runs also read the boxes before they
rebuild the description, so a choice made in between isn't lost.

::: {.callout-note}
## Wait for the check before merging
Each change takes about a minute, mostly for installing R. Meanwhile the
bot PR shows a pending check, "suggestion choices", which turns green
once the branch matches the boxes. Quick clicks queue up; waiting runs
are combined.
:::

The choices work on suggestion PRs into your branches and on
[full-review](suggestions.qmd#full-review) PRs alike. The
[author suggestions](authors-suggest.qmd) have no boxes: each of their
PRs is one change to `DESCRIPTION`.

## What happened to the suggestions {#outcome}

When a bot PR is merged or closed, the same caller (event type `closed`)
adds a hidden record to the PR's description: for each suggestion its
final box and whether it was kept, declined or never decided, the edits
you made to an accepted suggestion before merging, and review comments on
the files it touched, together with what made the suggestion
([provenance](suggestions.qmd#provenance)). It is only collected, to tune
the bots later; nothing leaves the repository. `outcome_record: false` in
`config/suggestion-policy.yml` turns it off.

## Example

{{< example suggestion-choices.yml >}}

The caller has to be on the **base branch** of the bot PRs: your feature
branches for suggestion PRs, `dev` for full reviews. Adding it to `dev`
covers both, since feature branches start from there. The `if:` keeps it
to roxygen and test bot PRs and to edits by a person — the bots' own
edits of the description don't start it.
